steps.title: Map changes to docs
steps.prompt: Merged PRs and commits: {{steps.diff.output_path}}. Write {{run.dir}}/map.md: which docs each PR affects, missing tutorial, how-to, reference or explanation pages, and the files for each of three update lanes (0, 1, 2). Do not edit the repository. Set breaking_no_doc to true when a breaking PR has no migration note in the docs, otherwise false.

steps.title: Update the docs
steps.prompt: You are update lane {{index}}. Edit only the files {{run.dir}}/map.md gives lane {{index}}. Stage your changes with git add. Never commit or push.

steps.title: Write the changelog
steps.prompt: From {{steps.diff.output_path}} and {{run.dir}}/map.md, write {{run.dir}}/release-notes.md and a new CHANGELOG.md section grouped Added, Changed, Fixed. Pick the semver bump from the PR labels. Every line names its PR and doc. Skip chores and say why. Stage CHANGELOG.md; never commit. Set version to the new tag as the repository writes its tags, for example v1.4.0.

steps.title: Run every sample
steps.prompt: Run every code sample in the docs touched by {{run.dir}}/map.md, check their links and each --help output. Fix a failing sample once and run it again. Write {{run.dir}}/samples.md. Set passed to true when every sample passes, otherwise false.

steps.title: Approve the release
steps.gate_summary: Release {{steps.changelog.outputs.version}} ({{steps.changelog.outputs.bump}} bump) of {{inputs.repo}} from {{inputs.base_branch}} with {{run.dir}}/release-notes.md. Samples passed: {{steps.samples.outputs.passed}}. Approve to tag and publish.
